stem.text: Two tugs are towing an oil rig as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of an oil rig with two towing cables. The upper cable is labelled 4.0 kN and is drawn at 20° above a dashed horizontal line; the lower cable is labelled 5.0 kN and is drawn at 50° below a dashed horizontal line. A tug is shown at the far end of each cable, and an arrow labelled east points to the right.

stem.text: The tensions in the towing cables are $4.0\,\text{kN}$ and $5.0\,\text{kN}$.
What is the total force acting on the rig due to the cables, in the direction to the east?
